responsibility: Implements the Intel MIC offload image construction tool used by GCC’s x86 offloading support. This standalone helper is invoked during OpenMP/OpenACC offload builds to locate the Intel MIC target compiler, forward the relevant command-line options and ABI mode, compile device code into a shared image, generate the host-side descriptor object, and then use ld/objcopy to package the result into a relocatable host object containing the device image in the .gnu.offload_images section with standardized __offload_image_intelmic_{start,end,size} symbols. It also manages temporary files, environment sanitization, argument expansion, and cleanup for this Intel MIC-specific offload packaging flow.
